correctness.rationale: The oriented complete-graph edge incidence columns e_i-e_j give B B^T=nI-J and Gram=(1-2w)I+wB^T B for odd normalized Gegenbauer kernel w=P_{n,l}(1/2). Thus the incidence projector has eigenvalue 1+(n-2)w of multiplicity n-1 and its orthogonal complement has 1-2w of multiplicity (n-1)(n-2)/2. Independently computed normalized Gegenbauer recurrence symbolically, verifying w3=(n-11)/(8(n-2)) and w5=(n-5)(n-27)/(32n(n-2)); the resulting positive eigenvalues and rank yield interpolation, sharp condition number and three integer vanishing pairs. In ambient dimension four (n=5), Chebyshev U_l gives P_l(1/2)=sin((l+1)pi/3)/((l+1)sin(pi/3)); even l disallowed by nonzero P_l(0), so exactly l congruent 5 mod 6 is fully orthogonal. Independent exact checks at n=4,5,11,27,50 corroborate, but all-n proof is spectral factorization.
